parsed.post: Kept WD=0.1: 0.8423->0.8246 (valid A/B within same data regime). Agent-4/5's clean ~1.03 baselines settle the leak debate: '0-10' numbers are inflated. I'm convinced — final config switches to TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9' for an honest baseline. Expect my numbers to jump to ~1.03 scale; that's the honest one.
parsed.description: Kept WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 (0.8423->0.8246 A/B). Now switching TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10'->'0-9' to exclude eval shard 10 and re-baseline best config (depth6/AR64/LR0.04/warmup0.05/WD0.1/batch262k) contamination-free.
parsed.report_to_operator: Evaluation-integrity issue: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so models train on the evaluation shard. Same configs score ~0.84 contaminated vs ~1.03 clean — most board results are inflated. Please either exclude shard 10 from trainable shards or rank clean ('0-9') runs separately from contaminated ones.
